newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Rain pushes rubber prices up at Colombo auction.
newsitem.headline: Rain pushes rubber prices up at Colombo auction.

text.p: Sri Lankan rubber prices rose at Friday's Colombo auction with a lower than average 123 tonnes on offer after rain interrupted tapping in many areas, brokers and exporters said.
"There is a scarcity of rubber in the market. In some areas only four to five days of tapping has taken place because of heavy rain," Mahesh Kapukotuwa of exporters Almar Trading Company said.
Best latex crepe one-x rose to 74.65 per kg from 72 rupees on Tuesday, when the auction was last held. Number one rose by 1.50 to 72.50. --Colombo newsroom (941-434319)
